amendments.normalized_body: In engine.rs lines 410-411, `substrate_oxygenation_breakdown()` is called once for tracing metrics, then `step_substrate_zones()` calls it again internally. Each invocation recomputes the full habitat registry via `compute_habitat_registry()`. Refactor `step_substrate_zones` to accept a pre-computed `SubstrateOxygenationBreakdown` (or return one alongside applying it) to avoid the redundant computation.

The removal of root respiration O₂ demand from `estimate_substrate_o2_demand_rate()` (previously ~10% of rooted biomass × BOD rate) means the model now only accounts for the O₂ *supply* side of root activity (ROL) without the corresponding O₂ *consumption* (root metabolism). Add a brief code comment in `estimate_substrate_o2_demand_rate` documenting this as a deliberate simplification and noting that net ROL already accounts for this in the literature-calibrated `rol_rate_cm_per_g` default.

The `substrate_root_activity_factor` computation at substrate.rs:348 uses `(surface_area_cm2 - footprint_area_cm2).max(0.0)` to isolate interstitial area. This is correct when SubstrateSurface = footprint + interstitial, but if the habitat registry formula ever changes, this subtraction will silently produce wrong results. Add an inline comment explaining the physical meaning: 'SubstrateSurface area includes footprint top surface; subtract it to get only interstitial grain-matrix area available for root colonization.'
